scope.purpose: Identify engineering still required after accepted W1 paper preview and existing code capture/retrieval, and bound successor contracts without implementing them.

code_capture_and_retrieval_design.source_boundary: caller supplies source-path bytes to code-map prepare; staged capture inspects a content-addressed text payload
code_capture_and_retrieval_design.retrieval_boundary: deterministic ranking/evaluation over validated published catalog evidence mapping

source_publication.status: semantics/publication accepted; conversion and catalog integration remain separate

source_conversion.interface_status: a terminal source clone contains conversion work and R3 review evidence, but status.json has no exact repository head acceptance; new discovery/code packets must not silently depend on an unaccepted interface

observed_contract: adapter is arxiv-abs-normalized-v1 and origin is one arxiv.org/abs page
one bounded request and one observation produce resolved arXiv metadata and an abstract-only preview
five preview artifact families use exact references and create-only .work session storage
the decision is append-only and preview/decision explicitly remain ingest_authorized=false
the accepted package has no provider-neutral search, citation traversal, cursor continuation, candidate set, round checkpoint, deterministic RRF, or stop/resume graph
closed_boundary: W1 connector request/observation schemas must remain byte-compatible and are not a general OpenAlex schema
W1 request budget and arXiv pacing are not provider-query or multi-round research semantics
candidate identity must resolve before invoking W1 paper request/preview/decide

observed_apis: source_versions.associate_source creates/reuses immutable source associations from exact raw/registration material
source_versions.make_display_decision and derive_display_heads keep display selection append-only
formal_source and source_conversion prepare a lightweight-to-formal publication request without agent-side apply
integration_limit: the active status row is not an exact-head accepted delivery
the APIs bind paper/source evidence but do not define discovery candidate handoff or paper-to-repository code relation semantics
code observations must bind an exact source association/version reference when one is selected and must never retarget a relation merely because display head changes

implemented: strict UTF-8 and line/newline normalization with raw and normalized hashes
repository/full-commit/path declaration and code line locators
retained staged capture with create/reuse transaction inspection and no agent-side Vault apply
published catalog collection of existing repo/code/alignment records and deterministic evidence-mapping retrieval
missing: the origin commit is caller-declared; code-map prepare accepts caller source-path bytes and does not prove they are the Git blob at that commit
no bounded repository/commit/tree/blob observation request or host connector observation schema exists
no multi-file same-commit collection with explicit roles, partial/missing semantics, or source-capability provenance exists
officiality is not an observation result plus independent relation review; repo-record/alignment v1 cannot express the proposed web/README/CITATION evidence without PDF locators
configuration evidence has no closed data-only parser contract for supported formats and hostile constructors/imports/scripts
no source-version-aware paper↔repository relation publication flow joins an inspected manifest, source association, relation review and a receipt-backed transaction
catalog/compiler/backup branches have no successor namespace for those relation records; adding them without explicit projection and restore coverage would make the new evidence non-rebuildable

findings.statement: The accepted preview package does not implement bounded online discovery, multi-provider observations, research rounds, candidate ranking, or resumable stopping.
required_behavior: OpenAlex read-only request/observation normalization for works search, references, citations and related works; provider limits and incomplete indexed references remain explicit
session/config/round-event graph with immutable exact refs, bounded budgets and complete-set verification on success and failure paths
stable identity resolution by OpenAlex/arXiv/DOI/crosswalk evidence; title similarity never merges entities and conflicts remain visible
candidate dedupe with why-found evidence, source-version visibility and no user-decision field
provider-local source ranks followed by deterministic integer-k RRF and canonical identity tie-break
stop decision with frozen precedence, consecutive-round metrics, explicit user stop and resume from the last complete immutable round
selected candidate handoff to W1 request/preview/decide only after exact identity validation; no implicit preview or catalog/Vault write

acceptance: parallelism 1 and N over the same frozen observations/config emit byte-identical candidates, ranks and stop decisions
stable duplicate IDs merge only with explicit identity evidence; conflicting IDs remain separate
cursor, per_page=100, approximate 4094-byte query, 429, missing capability and indexed-reference incompleteness produce stable bounded outcomes
malformed/oversized/duplicate-key/non-finite/deep JSON, symlink, stale, reordered and cross-session artifacts refuse without overwrite
candidate preview and append-only decision create only exact W1 references and never mutate Vault/catalog/index
no live OpenAlex payload is copied into checked-in fixtures; a separate held-out observation is required for access claims
non_goals: automatic retry or implicit cursor walk

findings.statement: Existing code capture proves text bytes and declared origin syntax but does not prove Git provenance, official repository status, capability evidence, or relation semantics.
required_behavior: bounded request binds canonical repository, paper ID and optional exact source-association/version reference, full commit and role-grouped explicit paths; no clone/archive/recursive traversal
immutable observation records exact repository/commit/tree/blob facts, requested versus observed transport, file inventory, per-file bytes or normalized-only capability, and missing/partial outcomes
same-commit multi-file evidence preserves logical paths even when bytes duplicate; a partial collection never becomes complete
capability proposal covers training, inference, preprocessing/data, evaluation and checkpoints with exact code/config/README locators or bounded absence search scope
config inspection is data-only, closed-format and refusal-safe; no imports, YAML object constructors, scripts or model loading
officiality remains an independent relation review with official/unofficial/unverified_candidate status and A/B/C/D evidence, not a model or discovery score
existing_reuse: existing source association and display-head references after exact SOURCE acceptance

acceptance: repository/commit/tree/blob/path mismatch and caller-byte-versus-declared-commit mismatch refuse with stable errors
raw bytes, normalized bytes, CRLF and duplicate-content-at-distinct-path identities remain distinct and correctly labeled
partial/missing files, bounded absence scans and same-commit role sets are deterministic and never upgraded to complete by ranking
hostile paths, symlinks, special files, duplicate-key/non-finite/deep JSON and oversized payloads refuse without egress or overwrite
config fixtures prove supported data-only formats while rejecting imports, constructors, scripts, executable expressions and model loads
fake officiality shortcuts are rejected; direct-release-without-backlink can remain official only with its recorded evidence gap; insufficient evidence remains unverified_candidate
observation emits a source-file handoff that reuses existing code-map prepare/inspect and never runs admin/apply or writes a Vault

findings.statement: Even a verified observation would remain disposable until an independent relation review and receipt-backed canonical publication can join it to the selected paper/source version and remain visible to catalog, retrieval, audit and backup.
missing_surfaces: successor alignment/relation schema that accepts web/README/CITATION/config evidence without manufacturing PDF locators
append-only relation review and capability proposal handoff with review actor/status/reason/evidence hashes
prospective publication transaction that binds inspected code manifests, source association, relation review, current Vault snapshot and source-version/display-head policy
successor compile/catalog inputs for relation namespaces, deterministic code page output and retrieval eligibility
integrity-audit and backup/restore inventory/restore coverage for every new canonical relation and evidence object
deliberate legacy refusal/read-only policy for old paper-code-alignment.v1 and compile-input.v1

acceptance: independent relation review is append-only, exact-hash-bound and cannot be synthesized by the model or discovery ranker
paper/source-association/version, repository, commit and inspected code manifest must all agree; display-head change cannot retarget old evidence
old v1 alignment/compile inputs remain byte-compatible and explicitly refuse unsupported v2 data rather than silently coercing PDF locators
publication prepare/inspect binds complete read set and prospective inventory; no partial Vault/catalog writes occur on refusal or stale snapshot
catalog, retrieval mapping, integrity audit and backup/isolated restore round-trip all new relation namespaces with deterministic bytes
real Vault/operator apply, official repository selection and human relation judgment remain externally recorded gates

cross_package_invariants: Python agent/research code remains zero-egress; network access, if any, is platform connector or external operator evidence only
all new artifacts use closed versioned schemas, exact JCS/reference hashes, bounded bytes/depth/counts and no symlink/special-file/traversal inputs
candidate, observation, capability and relation proposals remain disposable until explicit decision/review and receipt-backed publication
the managed 67-entry catalog seed/overlay remains unchanged
no W1 schema bytes, legacy v1 alignment semantics, source ledger, user notes, real Vault or operator authority are mutated
source-version associations and display heads are immutable evidence references; adding a new version does not supersede claims or retarget code relations
local fixtures and dual-Python results are engineering evidence only; actual connector capability, real repositories, licenses, human judgments and semantic quality remain separate gates
external_and_human_gates: held-out live OpenAlex/platform observation before claiming access, transport headers, authentication mode, rate-limit behavior or response completeness
real paper/repository trials with licenses and explicit officiality relation review
real captured source/Vault/operator apply and receipt-backed publication
human claim/support review, visual Obsidian review, backup anchor and merge/PR acceptance
builder_status: not_dispatchable_from_this review alone; Architect must freeze one successor packet after SOURCE exact-head interface and path ownership are recorded
blockers: SOURCE conversion is still marked in progress in status.json and lacks exact-head acceptance for a stable source-association handoff
OpenAlex live connector capability is documented-only in the W3 design review; no checked-in live payload may be promoted
code officiality is a semantic relation judgment and cannot be closed by schema validation or model ranking
